summary: Moved DmsTrack update order to face/head first, then body evidence, then hand.
Removed independent body identity allocation from tracking state.
Made m_bodyTracks keyed by head trackId so body/torso is head-owned evidence.
Preserved legacy body/face/left_hand/right_hand maps while publishing body/hand under head trackId.
Weighted driver head selection toward size continuity and hard-rejected small faces and front passenger ROI candidates.
identity_rule: head/face trackId is the only identity source; body/torso/hand evidence must inherit the corresponding head trackId.
